m0_element: M0.6 — Strategy, Market Data and Execution Routing

StrategyDefinition.identity: lowercase canonical UUIDv7 with exact prefix; names and symbols are not identity

StrategyInstance.identity: lowercase canonical UUIDv7 with exact prefix; names and symbols are not identity

MarketDataRoute.identity: lowercase canonical UUIDv7 with exact prefix; names and symbols are not identity

ExecutionRoute.identity: lowercase canonical UUIDv7 with exact prefix; names and symbols are not identity

RouteReadiness.identity: non-durable Core-owned projection keyed by exact route_id

hash.input: domain separator bytes + canonical configuration UTF-8

strategy_definition_contract.workspace_policy: Every create request workspace_id must exist; otherwise WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND.

strategy_instance_contract.first_bind_policy: Each route starts null and is independently first-bound once; a non-null binding is immutable; second binding makes BOUND; rebind requires a new StrategyInstance.

exclusive_lifecycle_operations.BOUND: derived only from completing both first binds

strategy_instance_contract.persisted_definition_policy: Exact pinned definition may be ACTIVE or RETIRED, never DRAFT; activation requires ACTIVE.

market_data_route_contract.freshness_policy: deterministic maximum age evaluated with validation_time_utc
market_data_route_contract.endpoint_access_policy: data_scope must exactly equal endpoint access_scope; PUBLIC forbids PRIVATE_* channels.

route_readiness_contract.identity: non-durable Core-owned projection keyed by exact mdr or xroute route_id

active_strategy_instances.semantics: exact IDs whose persisted lifecycle_state is ACTIVE

validation_stages: all record schemas and map-key bindings

universe_instrument_catalog: every instrument and source catalog exists
source catalog set exactly equals catalogs used by universe instruments
referential_integrity.bound_execution_adapter: ExecutionRoute.adapter_family_id == Instrument.source_adapter_family_id == Catalog.adapter_family_id; persisted mismatch is TRUSTED_CONTEXT_INVALID
referential_integrity.unbound_execution_candidate: adapter mismatch during bind is ROUTE_ADAPTER_MISMATCH
account_snapshot: VALID, STALE, and REJECTED are structurally canonical; TESTNET authorization evaluates operability

credential_map_policy.PAPER: null selection and empty map permitted
credential_map_policy.lifecycle_requirement: Every selected mapped profile is ACTIVE.

denial_semantics.CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT: corrupt machine contract only; never ordinary request, context, lifecycle, binding, readiness, or capability failure
denial_semantics.UNKNOWN_OPERATION: operation name is outside closed registry

dispatch_policy.interface: dispatcher(operation, request, context) -> immutable MappingProxyType decision; expected denial is never an input
dispatch_policy.planned_outcome_validation: required after operation validator success; inconsistent plans deny CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT
dispatch_policy.deep_immutability: decisions recursively freeze dicts as mapping proxies and lists as tuples

reachability_contract.graph_equality: union validator denials == allowed denials - CONTRACT_INCONSISTENT

cross_contract_references.M0.5: accounts, snapshots, credentials, instruments, catalogs, universes; no weakening

m04_product_capabilities.scope_semantics: M0.4 defines a global closed capability ID registry and separately environment capability booleans; extra canonical IDs grant no M0.6 authority and the environment-required ID remains mandatory
